from usg.dsl import *

# Point-to-point ENVIRONMENT navigation: reach a target on sidewalks/paths.
# Adapted to request: walk out onto road and stand on marked spot just past a crossing.
# Using crossing_8 on road_126 (signalised).

crossing = MAP.crossings(control="signals")[0]  # crossing_8
road = MAP.road(crossing["road"])  # road_126

# Start: sidewalk just before the crossing (right side)
start = MAP.sidewalk_at(road, "right", MAP.road_s_of(crossing) - 40.0)

# Destination: road surface just past the crossing (left side, end_side)
# Use MAP.crossing_side to get a place on the road surface at the end of the crossing
dest = MAP.crossing_side(crossing["id"], "end")

scenario = ScenarioBuilder("ptp_env_crossing", MAP, scenario_type="ptp_env",
                           description="Walk along the sidewalk to the road surface just past the crossing.")
scenario.user(start.facing(dest))
scenario.go_to(dest, "Walk along the sidewalk to the road surface just past the crossing",
               target_name="crossing_spot", tolerance=2.0, timeout=MAP.walk_time(start, dest),
               success="You reached the road surface just past the crossing.",
               failure="Time is up. Head for the road surface just past the crossing.")
